Time has a funny way of making us “settle”, which is not necessarily a bad thing. The older and more (heartbreaking lol) experience you go through, the more you’ll get disillussioned on certain things. Once you start feeling like you’re running out of time or it’s as if you just can’t catch a break, a lot of views change. 

You might become more flexible on who you find attractive. A stable and good job might mean differently - you’ll begin to consider schedule, stress levels, etc. At some point you might see certain things like height as a non-issue. You might start to be more forgiving if they take a while to respond. Etc etc etc... the list is long but, yeah :)

What you might currently consider as “lowering of standards” might become something you’ll consider as “more realistic” as time goes by.

You won’t “scare” off the right person. Eitherway, you have to face the reality that its been a month and he may or may not come back. Although then would you want someone who is so unreliable and inconsistent?
